name: PeopleSearch.im API
description: The same people-search backend as PeopleSearch.im, over HTTP. Search a global professional database in plain English, reveal full profiles, and fetch verified professional emails. Pay-as-you-go: 1 credit per profile, credits refunded when a lookup finds nothing. The same tools are also available to AI agents as a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server at https://peoplesearch.im/api/mcp.
